subject: Activation hold: required vendor evidence for account activation
messages:
From: Priya Naranjan <priya_naranjan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samir Kapoor <samir.kapoor@optimale.tech>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-01T15:12:00-08:00
Subject: Activation hold: required vendor evidence for account activation

Hi Samir,

Thanks for the productive call earlier — excited to get Optimale live in the Redwood Console. Procurement is holding activation pending a short set of vendor evidence items we need to complete finance and security reviews. Can you please return the following by EOD Tuesday (11/3) to avoid any further delay?

- Certificate of Insurance (COI) showing: General Liability $1M per occurrence / $2M aggregate, Employers Liability/Workers Comp as applicable, and professional liability / Tech E&O (if available). Please list Redwood Inference LLC as Additional Insured and include Waiver of Subrogation for General Liability.
- Completed Vendor Risk Questionnaire (attached: RiskQuestionnaire-Redwood-v1.docx) — several yes/no fields and a short SOC/ISO evidence area.
- W-9 for US tax remittance (or W-8 for non-US entities).
- Remittance information for PO setup (bank name, ACH details, remit address, invoices@optimale.tech contact).
- Any active subprocessor list or data processing attestation if handling customer data.

I've attached our Vendor-Onboarding-Checklist for reference. Finance (cc'd) will issue a provisional PO once COI + W-9 are received and we confirm additional insured language. Security will triage the questionnaire and may follow up with a narrow evidence request (SOC / penetration test summary) — we'll try to keep follow-ups minimal.

If getting the E&O requires a short lead time, let me know and include the expected timeline and cost impact; we can decide whether to proceed with a provisional PO conditioned on E&O delivery within X days.

Thanks — Priya

--
Priya Naranjan
Vendor Ops | Redwood Inference
priya_naranjan@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0124

Attachments: Vendor-Onboarding-Checklist.pdf, RiskQuestionnaire-Redwood-v1.docx

Subject: Re: Activation hold: required vendor evidence for account activation

Priya —

Appreciate the clear list. Attaching the COI and W-9 we have on file: Optimale_COI_20261106.pdf and Optimale_W9.pdf. Beacon (cc) is our broker and has pulled the COI; they can issue a revised certificate naming Redwood Inference LLC as Additional Insured and add the waiver, but the policy currently does not include Tech E&O. If E&O is mandatory, we will need to secure it — Beacon estimates a 7–10 business day process and a modest premium.

A few quick notes:
- COI limits: General Liability $1M/$2M aggregate (matches your ask).
- Auto liability included.
- No Tech E&O listed on current policy; Beacon can quote an endorsement.
- W-9 attached; remittance: Optimale Technologies LLC, ACH: Bank of Pacific, routing 121000358, acct xxxxxx1234 (see attached).

If Redwood can accept a provisional PO and a binding agreement to add E&O within 10 business days, we can move faster. Otherwise we will prioritize E&O and return final COI.

Best,
Samir

--

samir.kapoor@optimale.tech

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-04T11:36:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Activation hold: required vendor evidence for account activation

Priya / team —

Thanks Samir for the quick turnaround. A couple of procurement/finance notes:

1) We need the COI to explicitly name "Redwood Inference LLC" as Additional Insured and include a Waiver of Subrogation for General Liability. If Beacon can issue an updated COI with those fields, finance can proceed.

2) For PO setup, confirm the legal company name on the W-9 (we will use that for our vendor record) and provide an invoice example showing remit-to and payment terms.

3) On Tech E&O: our minimum for vendors who process customer signals or provide inference services is Tech E&O or a documented compensating control. If Optimale will be operating only as a data processor with no customer-derived model hosting, there may be room for negotiation. Please have Beacon indicate whether an E&O endorsement is available and the premium estimate.

4) If E&O can't be obtained within 10 business days, we can issue a provisional PO keyed to a conditional acceptance clause (PO will convert to firm after evidence is received). Procurement needs confirmation in writing from Optimale for either approach.

If you can get the COI update today, I can kick off the provisional PO and AP will put the vendor on our payment rails.

Laura

--
Laura Bennett
Manager, Finance Operations | Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com
From: Samir Kapoor <samir.kapoor@optimale.tech>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Priya Naranjan <priya_naranjan@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: broker@beaconins.com
Date: 2026-11-07T09:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Activation hold: required vendor evidence for account activation

Laura / Priya —

Beacon confirmed they can reissue the COI with Redwood Inference LLC as Additional Insured and the waiver of subrogation; they will deliver the updated certificate by EOD tomorrow (11/8). I asked them for a separate endorsement or quote for Tech E&O — initial estimate is ~7 business days to bind after quoting; Beacon will send the premium estimate today.

We are agreeable to a provisional PO that converts to firm on receipt of the E&O endorsement, provided the provisional PO documents the timeline and the conversion criteria. If you can share Redwood's template conditional PO language (or a short statement of acceptance), I will have our legal sign.

I'll attach Beacon's contact and the current COI/W-9 again for completeness.

Thanks — Samir

--
Samir Kapoor
Head of Procurement | Optimale Technologies
